kind: SHA512 round universal witness completeness and actual AIR trace bridge
formal_claims: For all bounded eight-word states and k/w inputs, the executable witness satisfies all round constraints.
Witness input decoding returns the supplied state and k/w exactly.
Actual AIR Holds implies the decoded round output equals the specification round.
At every legal height, a family of bounded inputs constructs a satisfying isolated round trace.
limitations: Trace rows are independent; no consecutive-round constraint is claimed.
k and w remain inputs, with no constant-table or message-schedule binding.
Full SHA512 schedule, chaining, feed-forward, padding and digest binding remain.
Full NEAR semantics, 1 Pgas proving, sub-300 KB proofs and 128-bit quantum security remain unverified.
